name: Do banquettes typically include storage options?

mainEntity.name: Do banquettes typically include storage options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Banquettes can be designed with various storage options, making them a functional choice for many homes. Common storage solutions include lift-top seats, pull-out drawers, or open shelving integrated into the base of the bench. The inclusion of storage adds to the banquette's utility, providing a convenient place for items like kitchen linens, board games, or seasonal decor. When planning your banquette, decide early if storage is a priority, as it affects the design and construction, often adding to the overall cost and complexity of the unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many banquettes include storage like lift-top seats or drawers, which adds functionality but impacts design and cost.
